summary: Frontend-only mobile preview verification of Analytics Pelanggan at 375x667. Preview loaded without red screen; period selection, KPI updates, region interaction, insights, bottom navigation, and horizontal overflow checks were exercised.
action_items: Consider adding explicit testID values to period picker, KPI cards, segment rows, region rows, chart hit targets, and bottom-nav items for robust regression coverage.
critical_code_review_comments: Analytics data is intentionally local sample data as requested; no backend integration is wired. The current implementation has accessibility roles but no explicit testID attributes on the primary interactive controls, making automated coverage less robust.
seed_data_creation: None; existing local sample snapshots were used.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified at https://ummu-bos-app.preview.emergentagent.com with 375x667 viewport. Sep 2026 -> Agu 2026 updates KPI and displayed period; region selection shows Makassar: 40 pelanggan aktif; insight cards and fixed Analytics nav are visible; no horizontal overflow or DOM error messages. Segment selection was tapped but assertion used the wrong expected text: implementation renders `Pelanggan Loyal: 42 profil (33%)`.
rca_of_issue: No product defect reproduced. The initial automation failures were strict-mode locator ambiguity from repeated month/KPI/chart labels and an incorrect expected segment string; corrected by using the period button role and first/unique locators. The document scrollHeight check is not reliable for this React Native web ScrollView, although the screenshot showed the page at the lower content and fixed nav remained visible.
